name: pdb_contact
description: Residue contact graphs from 473 PDB chains. Nodes are residues labelled by amino acid type; edges join C-alpha pairs within 5.5 A and are weighted by that distance; the edge label is sequence separation, consecutive or not, and is never derived from the distance. Dropped 27 chains under 30 residues, 0 with too few standard residues, 0 unreadable.
